messages.subject: For Wood executive leadership | Government relations, ESG and project stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Wood Press Office,

Please place this executive introduction before the appropriate member of Wood senior leadership.

Wood operates at the intersection of energy, infrastructure, project delivery, regulation and community expectations. That combination closely matches the external and cross-functional leadership work I manage today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across complex mining, energy and infrastructure matters.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of owner-operator perspective, institutional engagement and stakeholder execution could support Wood's international business. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Wood.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
